FOREWORD 

This Indian Standard ( First Revision ) was adopted by the Bureau of Indian Standards, after the draft 
finalized by the Milling Cutters, Saws, Gear Cutting Tools and Broaches Sectional Committee had been 
approved by the Production Engineering Division Council. 

This standard was first published in 1964. The standard has been revised to meet the changing need of the 
industries. 

Following changes are made in this revision: 

a) Diameter and nominal length have been rationalized, and 

b) Style of indicated designation and sampling clause have been incorporated. 

Other standards published in this series are: 

IS 6550 : 1991 Thread milling cutter with parallel shanks {first revision ) 

IS 6551 : 1991 Thread milling cutter with morse taper shank — Specifcatittt ( first revision ) 

In the formulation of this standard, assistance has been derived from DIN 852 ( Wil 1 )-1978 'Shell type 
thread milling cutters for ISO metric screw threads — Dimensions', issued by the Deutsches Institut fiir 
Normung ( Germany ). 



IS 2670 1 1991 



Indian Standard 

THREAD MILLING CUTTER SHELL TYPE 

SPECIFICATION 

( First Revision J 



1 SCOPE 

This standard covers dimensions and other 
requirements for ground thread milling cutter 
( shell type ) with cylindrical recess for milling 
ISO metric screw threads having a pitch 0*5 to 
3 mm and conforming to IS 4218 ( Part 2 ) : 1976 
*ISO metric screw threads : Part 2 Diameter pitch 
combinations (first revision )\ 

2 REFERENCES 

The following Indian Standards are necessary 
adjuncts to this standard:

3 TERMINOLOGY 

Shall be as given in IS 1830 : 1982. 



4 DIMENSIONS 

4.1 Main Dimensions 

Shall be as given in Table 1 read with Figure. 

4.2 The dimensions of the cutting portion of the 
milling cutters shall be suitable for producing 
ISO Metric screw threads conforming to IS 4218 
( Parts 1 to 6 ) : 1976= 

5 MATERIAL AND HARDNESS 

Shall be in accordance with IS 1830 : 1982. 

6 GENERAL REQUIREMENTS 

6.1 Thread milling cutter ( shell type ) shall be 
supplied with straight flutes unless otherwise 
specified. 

6.2 Material and other requirements shall be 
according to IS 1830 : 1982, 

7 DESIGNATION 

A thread milling cutter ( shell type ) having a 
diameter d\ = 40 mm, nominal length 32 mm* 
suitable for milling screw threads having a pitch. 
P =as 2 mm shall be designated as: 

Shell Type Thread Milling Cutter IS 2670 — 
40 x 32 x 2 

8 SAMPLING 

The sampling and criteria of acceptance shall b& 
according to IS 7778 : 1975. 

9 MARKING 

Shaii be according to IS 1830 : 1982. 

10 PROTECTIVE COATING AND 
PACKAGING 

Shall be according to IS 1830 : 1982.

Standard Mark 

The use of the Standard Mark is governed by the provisions of the Bureau of Indian Standards 
Act) 1986 and the Rules and Regulations made thereunder. The Standard Mark on products 
covered by an Indian Standard conveys the assurance that they have been produced to comply 
with the requirements of that standard under a well defined system of inspection, testing and 
quality control which is devised and supervised by BIS and operated by the producer. Standard 
marked products are also continuously checked by BIS for conformity to that standard as a 
further safeguard. Details of conditions under which a licence for the use of the Standard Mark 
may be granted to manufacturers or producers may be obtained from the Bureau of 
Indian Standards. 



Bureau of Indian Standards 

BIS is a statutory institution established under the Bureau of Indian Standards Act, 1986 to promote 
harmonious development of the activities of standardization, marking and quality certification of goods 
and attending to connected matters in the country. 

Copyright 

BIS has the copyright of all its publications. No part of these publications may be reproduced in any 
form without the prior permission in writing of BIS. This does not preclude the free use, in the course of 
implementing the standard, of necessary details, such as symbols and sizes, type or grade designations, 
Enquiries relating to copyright be addressed to the Director ( Publications ), BIS. 

Revision of Indian Standards 

Indian Standards are reviewed periodically and revised, when necessary and amendments, if any, are 
fssued from time to time. Users of Indian Standards should ascertain that they are in possession of the 
latest amendments or edition. Comments on this Indian Standard may be sent to BIS giving the 
following reference: 

Doc: No. PE11 (5044)
